name: dsh-plugin-version-management

one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 设置页提供插件版本快照与恢复界面。
one_liner.en: Adds a DSH settings panel for plugin version snapshots and restore.

readme_mismatch: README describes snapshot and restore tools and host routes, but lib/index.js contains only generated restore-script strings and does not register tools or implement the /dsh-pvm/* routes called by the client.

completeness.reason: Host entry exports package metadata but lacks the described tools and route handlers.

code.reason: The client UI is organized into a panel and helper functions, while the host entry is only a partial script template.

docs.reason: README includes installation, settings-page, conversation, and recovery instructions.

maintenance.reason: The repository has 30 commits; the recorded last push is 2026-08-29.

tests.reason: No test files are present in the extracted repository facts.

quality.notes: C-lite review covered all runtime entry, client UI, bundle registration, manifest, and README; no test or CI files were present.
